original_question_en: List the change summaries of CRs approved at meeting RAN3#123 (meeting-outcome review).
original_query: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE m.meetingNumberInt = 123 WITH a MATCH (a)-[:REFERENCES]->(c:CR) WHERE c.reasonForChange IS NOT NULL RETURN c.tdocNumber, c.summaryOfChange ORDER BY c.tdocNumber DESC LIMIT 10

paragraphs.text: 1. Users shall not use the network to engage in illegal activities. This includes activities such as copyright violation, hacking, espionage or any other activity that may be prohibited by local laws.
2. Users shall not engage in non-work related activities that are consume excessive bandwidth or cause significant degradation of the performance of the network.
And most importantly:
1. DON’T place your WiFi device in ad-hoc mode;
2. DON’T set up a personal hotspot in the meeting room;
3. DO try 802.11a if your device supports it;
4. DON’T manually allocate an IP address;
5. DON’T stream video, play online games, or download huge files;
6. DON’T use packet probing software (e.g., packet sniffers or port scanners) which clogs the local network.
2.4	Additional reminders

1. All agreed CRs must be provided during the meeting week, that is, BEFORE the end of the meeting. In order to continue with the principle of “agreed unseen” CRs, please make sure that all such CRs are uploaded in time and that they contain exactly the agreed changes.
2. During physical meetings, prefer face-to-face offline discussion to e-mail discussion.

register.Secretary Remarks: Source modified on 2/19/2024. Original source : Ericsson

decisions.text: Decision: 		The document was revised to R3-240942.

predecessor_values:
Remove from the Handover Preparation procedure the paragraph related to Redundant DL Forwarding UP TNL Information”  

Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release):
This CR has an isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release).
current_values:
Remove from the Handover Preparation procedure the paragraph related to Redundant DL Forwarding UP TNL Information”  

Impact assessment towards the previous version of the specification (same release):
This CR has an isolated impact towards the previous version of the specification (same release).

predecessor_values:
During XnAP review, it was revealed that the Redundant DL Forwarding UP TNL Information IE” is used in the procedure text in section 8.2.1.2, but not referenced in the protocol definition in section 9. 
The procedural text indicates that such IE is used for data forwarding for the Redundant QoS, but there is no corresponding IE definition.
The Redundant QoS was introduced in Rel-16 NR-IioT. After checking the RAN3 meeting discussion, it is clear that companies do not see the need to specify the data forwarding tunnel for the redundant QoS Flow now during NG and Xn Handover. 
With respect to the conclusion, the procedual text should be corected by removing the Redundant DL Forwarding UP TNL Information related paragraph.

all_seven_postmeeting_and_two_different_.prior_temporal_judgment: The current same-ID report 'agreed' and after-meeting reservation/abstract establish final report-associated acceptance and an explicitly later revision. They do not independently establish when the shown current revision/body was approved during the physical meeting. Text equality of a cover summary alone would not prove unchanged body or prior same-time approval.
